limitations: Lexical/structural extraction, not a complete GDScript AST or runtime trace.
Only unqualified/self-qualified same-class function calls are resolved; dynamic/member receivers and inherited calls are omitted.
Exact project class type references require a unique declaration; preload aliases retain file links without invented call bindings.
Computed resource paths, runtime-created Control hierarchies, inherited scene expansions and user:// state are not resolved.
Absent resource literals can be path prefixes or test cases, rather than broken runtime dependencies.
UID resolution uses authored sidecars and scene/resource headers, never the generated Godot cache.
